scenarios.title: A｜拒绝退款
scenarios.setting: 玩家拿着刚购买不久的商品和收据来到柜台。

turns.text: Hi. I’d like to return this and get a refund.
I’m sorry, but this item isn’t refundable.

turns.prompt: 你想了解退换或退款的处理办法，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you explain why it can’t be refunded?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you explain why it can’t be refunded?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I bought it yesterday and I still have the receipt.

feedback.naturalExpression: I bought it yesterday and I still have the receipt.
feedback.explanation: “receipt”指收据或付款小票，是交易凭证。

choices.text: I haven’t used it. Is there any exception?

feedback.naturalExpression: I haven’t used it. Is there any exception?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: If a refund isn’t possible, could I exchange it instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: If a refund isn’t possible, could I exchange it instead?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: Why can’t you give my money back?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Could you explain why it can’t be refunded?
feedback.explanation: 反问为什么不退钱容易变成争执；问清退款条件或拒绝原因，才便于继续协商。

turns.text: It’s a final-sale item, so normally we can’t accept returns.

turns.prompt: 你想说明购买时对退货限制并不知情，会怎么说？

choices.text: I wasn’t aware it was final sale when I bought it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wasn’t aware it was final sale when I bought it.
feedback.explanation: “final sale”通常指不退换的最终销售；提到是否知情，能说明争议来自哪项条件。

choices.text: Was that stated somewhere at the time of purchase?

feedback.naturalExpression: Was that stated somewhere at the time of purchase?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Could you show me the return policy?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you show me the return policy?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Is there anything else you can offer instead of a refund?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything else you can offer instead of a refund?
feedback.explanation: “instead of”引出想替换掉的选项，让对方清楚比较的是哪两个方案。

scenarios.title: B｜服务态度不好
scenarios.setting: 玩家正常询问问题，但工作人员一直表现得很不耐烦。

turns.text: I already told you. There’s nothing I can do.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand what you’re saying, but I’d appreciate it if we could keep this conversation respectful.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand what you’re saying, but I’d appreciate it if we could keep this conversation respectful.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

choices.text: I’m just trying to understand my options.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m just trying to understand my options.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: There’s no need to speak to me like that.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s no need to speak to me like that.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: I’d like to resolve this calmly.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to resolve this calmly.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Why are you being so rude to me?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I understand what you’re saying, but I’d appreciate it if we could keep this conversation respectful.
feedback.explanation: 直接评价对方“rude”可能让讨论转向互相指责；说明哪句话让自己不舒服，更便于澄清。

turns.text: I’m not being rude. I’m just explaining the policy.

turns.prompt: 你想说明对方的沟通方式让你感到不被尊重，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s fine, but the way you’re speaking to me feels dismissive.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine, but the way you’re speaking to me feels dismissive.
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: I’m happy to discuss the policy, but I’d like to be treated respectfully.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m happy to discuss the policy, but I’d like to be treated respectfully.
feedback.explanation: “I'm happy”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

choices.text: If you can’t help me, could I speak to someone else?

feedback.naturalExpression: If you can’t help me, could I speak to someone else?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

scenarios.title: C｜要求见负责人
scenarios.setting: 在“商家拒绝自己的要求”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“要求见负责人”。

turns.text: Could I speak to a manager, please?
The manager is busy right now. What’s the issue?

turns.prompt: 你想说明问题仍需负责人协助解决，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’ve tried to resolve this here, but we haven’t been able to.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve tried to resolve this here, but we haven’t been able to.
feedback.explanation: “haven’t”与过去分词搭配说明截至现在仍未完成的事，方便对方判断当前进度。

choices.text: I’d prefer to discuss the situation with a manager.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d prefer to discuss the situation with a manager.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: I have a question about the store’s refund policy that I’d like them to clarify.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have a question about the store’s refund policy that I’d like them to clarify.
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: I’m happy to wait until someone is available.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m happy to wait until someone is available.
feedback.explanation: “I'm happy”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

choices.text: Call your manager now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve tried to resolve this here, but we haven’t been able to.
feedback.explanation: “now”加强命令感；坚定要求联系负责人时，仍可用“Could I speak to your manager?”。

turns.text: It might be about ten minutes.

turns.prompt: 关于「商家拒绝自己的要求」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s fine. I’ll wait.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. I’ll wait.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: No problem. Could you let them know I’d like to speak with them?

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. Could you let them know I’d like to speak with them?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Sure. Where should I wait?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Where should I wait?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。
